item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya notices that a new money plant has grown from a stem cutting her grandmother placed in a bottle of water at home.

Which statement explains why this is an example of vegetative propagation rather than reproduction by seeds?

options.A: The new plant grew faster than a plant grown from a seed.
options.B: The new plant grew from a part of a single parent plant, not from a seed formed by two parents.
options.C: The new plant grew in water instead of in soil.
options.D: The new plant has shiny green leaves like the parent plant.
